description: This file contains shell script functions related to firmware upgrade processes for Linksys devices, including methods to determine target firmware partitions, check factory images, and perform platform-specific upgrade procedures.

methods.name: linksys_get_target_firmware
methods.description: Determines the target firmware partition based on current boot environment and UBI settings.

methods.name: linksys_is_factory_image
methods.description: Checks whether a given firmware image matches the device's footer signature, indicating it's a factory image.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_linksys
methods.description: Performs device-specific firmware upgrade procedures, including handling different magic number formats and UBI volume management.
